Location Omaha, NE Requisition Number: 2026 - 099 Department Emergency Medicine 50000655 Business Unit(College/Institute) College of Medicine FTE: 100 Reg-Temp Full-Time Regular Work Schedule Varied Requisition Category Faculty Requisition Title Academic EM Physician/Faculty Rank DOQ Job Title/Academic Rank Academic EM Physician/Faculty Rank DOQ Additional Requisition Title Appointment Type DOQ - DEPENDS ON QUALS Salary Range Salary Commensurate with Experience Job/EEO Category Faculty Job Requisition Begin Date 03/04/2026 Position Qualification Position Summary The Department of Emergency Medicine at the University of Nebraska Medical Center in Omaha, Nebraska is recruiting Emergency Medicine physicians to be an integral part of our faculty. The incoming faculty member will join a collegial team of Emergency Medicine physicians that are dedicated to providing extraordinary patient care to all. We are home to a well-established and fully accredited three-year emergency medicine residency program that offers 12 positions per year.The physician faculty for the Department of Emergency Medicine provide professional medical services at both Nebraska Medicine and Nebraska Medicine-Bellevue Medical Center. Nebraska Medicine is a nationally certified Level I Trauma Center, with a busy, high acuity ED serving nearly 65,000 patients annually, providing excellent physician and advanced practice provider coverage and 24/7 Emergency Medicine resident coverage. The community emergency department at Bellevue Medical Center is the second busiest ED in the state, with a census of over 35,000 visits annually.As Nebraska’s only public academic health sciences center, UNMC and Nebraska Medicine are committed to the education of a 21st century health care work force, to finding cures and treatments for devastating diseases, to providing the best care for patients, and to serving our state and its communities through award-winning outreach.The successful candidate must be an MD/DO (or equivalent degree) who is board certified or board eligible in Emergency Medicine and possess excellent clinical, professional, and communication skills. Preference will be given to candidates with experience in academic emergency medicine and/or has completed fellowship or advanced training.We offer a highly competitive benefits package and rank and salary commensurate with qualifications. Note - Due to this being an ongoing job advertisement, only applicants selected for interviews will be contacted; turn-down notices will not be provided. Position Details Position Information Position Title Adjunct Faculty - College of Business Unit College of Business Job Location Crete, NE (68333) Description of Work Doane University, a nationally recognized liberal arts and sciences university in Nebraska, invites applications for Adjunct Faculty in the College of Business. The newly-formed College of Business offers undergraduate programs in the following areas: Accounting, Agribusiness, Business Administration, Economics, and Leadership. We offer minors in each of these areas, as well as in Finance, Human Resource Management, Management, and Marketing. At the graduate level, we offer an MBA and a Master of Arts in Leadership. The College of Business offers classes in Crete, Lincoln, and online. Our residential campus is located in Crete, with classes offered during the day in 16-week semesters. Most students in Crete are recent high school graduates. The Lincoln campus is geared toward working adults, with classes offered one night a week in the evening during 8-week terms. Most classes meet in person, but a few meet via distance learning. We also offer asynchronous, online classes during the 8-week terms. Candidates will only be considered for academic areas that they are qualified to teach according to our accrediting bodies.For further inquiries on the position, please email daniel.bothe@doane.edu Doane University actively works to create and sustain a welcoming learning community for all members to fulfill their potential, feel valued, and make meaningful contributions to the university. Doane University is an equal-opportunity employer and seeks candidates who reflect the diversity of our society. In accordance with USCIS regulations, successful applicants must be legally able to accept work in the United States. Doane is unable to sponsor applicants for work visas. HOW TO APPLY:If you are interested in teaching a class offered through the College of Business, Click on “Apply for this Job." You will then either create an application or edit your current application that is on file. You will be required to attach a cover letter, curriculum vitae, teaching philosophy, and one PDF of transcripts of all graduate work in MS Word or PDF format.In your cover letter, clearly state which academic areas you are interested in teaching, as well as which locations (Crete, Lincoln) and modalities (in-person, distance learning, and online) you are willing to teach. Official transcript of terminal degree or degree in progress will be required as a condition for employment. Minimum Required Qualifications A master’s degree is required.
